message: The other day, I was cooking up a storm in the kitchen when I accidentally set off the smoke alarm. You’d think the house was on fire with how my family lit up the group chat! Between the jokes about my cooking skills and the serious reminders to check the smoke alarms, it turned into a hilarious but eye-opening moment. It made me realize how important it is to have a fire escape plan that everyone knows—even if it’s just to keep the laughs coming during a little kitchen mishap. How do you keep your family in the loop about safety?
